review.readiness_note: Sign off the connected Connections screen at 1440×900. The supplied Lab image is Home, so this is a system-level transfer assessment rather than a same-screen layout comparison. The capture exposes the expected records, states, actions and navigation; it cannot verify disconnect mutations or destination loading.
review.why: The production screen carries the approved mineral/graphite palette, typography hierarchy, rail proportions and restrained control treatment into a quiet management layout. Instagram and Google have aligned, full-size actions, with account identity, connection status and read time clearly separated. Thin rules organise the services without introducing floating cards. The small real account image is sufficient media for this purpose. There is no source-to-commitment boundary requiring a 24px joint, so its omission avoids decorative branding. No money belongs on this route, and none is invented. Business selection, Settings navigation, See what was read, Open Google Business and both Disconnect actions remain visible. No release-blocking visual drift is evident.
review.verdict: Frame Shift was faithfully transferred to this desktop Connections screen, with the real connected-state functionality visibly preserved.
